items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we were very good friends, from Chicago

ctx.x: But wow, that's just amazing. I don't think I'll read any more of those books. I'll just -- any way, I worked there with Roy for quite a while. And the Three Deuces was quite a club in that anybody who was anybody in the music

business, any touring band, that was their hang out. You know, this is -- so consequently I met all of the better musicians. So when I went to New York I knew everyone, you know, it was just like being in Chicago because they all knew me from the Deuces Three Duces. And especially Gene Krupa. I used to go down to the Paramount Theatre to see him, he was appearing there, and Ray Bianci was the guitarist there, and he also was a violin player. He was with Gene Krupa.

And so I used to -- and Roy, I think Roy worked with Gene for quite a while. I think, I know he did. But I used to go down to see them because Gene -- we were very good friends, from Chicago, and as I say evidently the critics weren't around then.
